pawn.push: Gaining space and controlling key squares
pawn.advance_wing: Creating attacking chances on the flank

knight.centralize: Knights are strongest in the center where they control many squares
knight.outpost: Placing the knight on a square where it can't be attacked by pawns
knight.defend: Protecting an important piece or square

bishop.fianchetto: Placing on the long diagonal for maximum influence
bishop.pin: Restricting an opponent's piece by threatening what's behind it
bishop.exchange: Trading bishops (often good if you have knights)

rook.open_file: Controlling an open file for penetration
rook.seventh_rank: Invading the 7th rank to attack pawns from behind
rook.defend: Protecting the back rank or key pawns
rook.connect: Connecting rooks so they protect each other

queen.centralize: Placing the queen where it has many options
queen.coordinate: Working with other pieces for threats
queen.retreat: Moving to safety while maintaining activity

king.castle: Getting the king to safety and connecting rooks
king.activate: In endgames, the king becomes a fighting piece
king.shelter: Maintaining pawn protection for the king
king.centralize: Moving to the center in endgames

development.idea: Getting pieces off their starting squares to active positions

castle.idea: Protecting the king and connecting the rooks
castle.principle: Castle early to ensure king safety

capture.principle: Every capture should improve your position, not just win material

trade.principle: Trade when ahead in material, avoid trades when behind

prophylaxis.idea: Preventing opponent's plan before it becomes dangerous
prophylaxis.principle: Ask 'what does my opponent want to do?' before each move

attack.idea: Creating threats against opponent's pieces or king
attack.principle: Attack only when your pieces are ready

defense.principle: Defense is not passive - look for counterplay

pawn_break.idea: Opening lines by advancing and exchanging pawns
pawn_break.principle: Pawn breaks create opportunities but also weaknesses

hanging_piece.lesson: Before every move, check: are all my pieces protected?

missed_threat.what_happened: You didn't see what your opponent was threatening
missed_threat.lesson: Before moving, ask: what is my opponent trying to do?

early_queen.what_happened: You brought your queen out too early
early_queen.lesson: The queen is vulnerable to attacks from minor pieces - develop others first

undeveloped.what_happened: You moved a developed piece again instead of developing others
undeveloped.lesson: Try to move each piece only once in the opening until all are developed

king_safety.what_happened: Your king became exposed to attack
king_safety.lesson: Castle early and keep pawns in front of your king

tactical_miss.lesson: Check for checks, captures, and threats on every move
